title: Invoiced work order whose customer is on Credit Hold and payer is not
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced (not paid), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  2. Change Credit Terms to Credit Hold.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • Credit Terms shows Credit Hold.

Step 3:

  • Customer A is saved on Credit Hold.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Invoiced.
  • The banner reads "This customer is on Credit Hold!", as today.
  • Customer B, the payer, is still on COD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-N4: “Once invoiced, the banner reads as today.”
  • S7-N1: “The customer's own Credit Hold does not block when someone else is billed.”
